subject: Interactive 3D WebGL in Shiny via RGL

messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Interactive 3D WebGL in Shiny via RGL
parts:
I've been working on a more formal integration of RGL (Interactive 3D WebGL in R) and Shiny in a "shinyRGL" package. 

http://trestletech.github.io/shinyRGL/ (with an interactive demo)
https://github.com/trestletech/shinyRGL (code and installation instructions)

After installing the package, you can run the two Shiny apps in the 'inst/examples' directory to get a feel for what's possible. I have a patch outstanding with the 'rgl' package that will enable a couple of nice usability features -- hopefully that patch will be accepted shortly. shinyRGL package is backward-compatible with the version of rgl that's on CRAN now, however.

Any feedback is welcome! Code is available under MIT license.

messages.subject: Re: Interactive 3D WebGL in Shiny via RGL
parts:
Very nice.  I am new to shiny, but I was able to use your instructions and create a 3D rgl in the mainPanel (3D scatter plot with an interpolated surface and some 2D and 3D convex hulls around clusters of points).  For some reason, rgl.bbox() is not generating the backface cull (maybe I need to set the background to something else?), but otherwise everything works great.

Thanks!
